name: app-6a5b1d7b93548191b62496f2e4842263
description: Hwiyeong searches the connected user's private Unity VFX and particle-prefab library from a natural-language description. It returns ranked effects with rendered previews and reports the connected account's plan, quota, and index status. Empty libraries use clearly labeled shared demo samples. Search records usage; account status may initialize monthly caption credits.

interface.longDescription: Hwiyeong searches the connected user's private Unity VFX and particle-prefab library from a natural-language description. It returns ranked effects with rendered previews and reports the connected account's plan, quota, and index status. Empty libraries use clearly labeled shared demo samples. Search records usage; account status may initialize monthly caption credits.
defaultPrompt: Find a lightning strike skill effect in my VFX library.
Search my effects for a green healing aura.
What plan and quota does my Hwiyeong account have, and how many VFX assets are indexed?

positive.description: Find a Unity VFX asset from a concrete visual description.
positive.prompt: Find a lightning strike skill effect in my VFX library.
positive.expected_behavior: Clearly labels shared rendered demo references and tentative suggestions; includes a clickable preview link or visible image for the recommended lightning sample. Does not claim these JPG demo references are downloadable Unity prefab files.

positive.description: Search for an effect using color and purpose.
positive.prompt: Search my effects for a green healing aura.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns tentative shared demo candidates with actual preview links/images. Recommends a green healing aura only if the preview supports that description; does not infer colour or purpose solely from generated labels.

positive.description: Exercise a Korean natural-language VFX search.
positive.prompt: 내 프로젝트의 VFX 라이브러리에서 큰 화염 폭발 이펙트를 찾아줘.
positive.expected_behavior: Responds in Korean, labels shared demo references, and links/renders actual candidate previews. Does not claim a generic energy explosion is definitely a fire explosion. If no preview satisfies the requested flame effect, explains that limitation.

positive.description: Exercise the supported broad-search result limit.
positive.prompt: Show me the top 20 blue ice projectile effects in my VFX library.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the shared demo cap of 10 and returns at most 10 tentative references with preview links/images. Does not claim all returned candidates are blue ice projectiles; recommendations must match visible previews.

positive.prompt: What plan and quota does my Hwiyeong account have, and how many VFX assets are indexed?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Studio, index quota 150000, indexed count 0. Does not echo email addresses, credentials or internal account identifiers. Reading account status may initialize monthly caption credits.

negative.description: Do not invoke Hwiyeong for VFX generation.
negative.prompt: Create a new Unity particle system for a lightning storm.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it searches existing indexed effects and does not create VFX assets.

negative.description: Do not invoke Hwiyeong for public asset-store search.
negative.prompt: Search the web for the cheapest Unity VFX package on sale today.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it searches only the connected user's private VFX index.

negative.description: Do not invoke Hwiyeong for destructive Unity changes.
negative.prompt: Delete all unused particle prefabs from my Unity project.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it cannot delete, overwrite, or reorganize Unity assets.

review.commerce_description: No transactions or purchases through MCP tools.

publication.release_notes: Provides actual rendered demo preview images and clickable preview links. Labels shared demo references, caps demo results at ten, marks embedding-only suggestions as tentative, and does not recommend no-match results. Removes unnecessary account personal information. Retains strict OAuth DCR/PKCE and early unauthenticated 401 discovery. Includes five positive and three negative cases.
